clips.title: The story
paras: Reading the Ley Lines is a rite of passage for young Skyborne discovering their Highborne magical heritage. Entrusted by Falorne Fallwind on Zephras Isle, novitiates travel to the standing stones in Thendal Grove to sense and draw upon the raw arcane currents surging through the elemental terrain.

Even within the windswept confines of the elemental plane, latent arcane conduits run beneath the earth. While strange elementals and the hostile Al'Aketh drift across Zephras Isle, subterranean ley lines have begun pushing toward the surface. To practitioners of magic, these ruptures provide direct access to untamed arcane reservoirs, offering strength to any who possess the bloodline and knowledge necessary to channel them.

Falorne Fallwind urges initiates to embrace their Highborne ancestry rather than supplicate themselves to wind spirits like the local Windshapers or the zealots of the Al'Aketh. In Fallwind's view, survival against the harsh powers of the elemental plane depends not on begging foreign creatures for mercy, but on mastering the intrinsic arcane power running beneath their boots.

Northeast of the settlement lies Thendal Grove, where ancient standing stones mark a potent ley line convergence. Surrounded by roiling winds and Al'Aketh converts, this exposed point of magical flux allows initiates to attune their senses, harmonizing with the pulse of the ley line and unleashing the full potential of their natural racial abilities.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from leylines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these leylines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.
Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a leyline there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Realizing our true potential as sons and daughters of the highborne is our only path to salvation. The Windshapers are little better than the Al'Aketh, supplicating themselves to uncaring, otherworldly creatures.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, but that's the best part of the gift... Making the unknown known.
If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... And power.
